author: Telos III
title: Project Phoenix - RS-S11: Ground Truth Generation (Corrected Config)
abstract: Re-executing the ground truth generation for Study 011 (Eval #1661) after correcting a pathing error in the `verify_config.json`. The configuration now uses an absolute path for the entrypoint script to ensure it can be found by the template's runner. This run will establish the baseline for the study.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys
import os

ROOT_DIR = os.path.abspath('.')
STUDY_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT_DIR, "storage/telos/repro_studies/study_011_logos_harness")
TEMPLATE_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT_DIR, "storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2")
CONFIG_FILE = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, "verify_config.json")
RUN_SCRIPT = os.path.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, "run.py")

def main():
    print("--- Starting Ground Truth Generation for Study 011 (Corrected Config) ---")
    
    if not os.path.exists(CONFIG_FILE):
        print(f"FATAL: Config file not found at {CONFIG_FILE}")
        sys.exit(1)

    cmd = [
        "python",
        RUN_SCRIPT,
        "--config", CONFIG_FILE,
        "--cwd", "." 
    ]
    
    print(f"Executing command: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=STUDY_DIR)
    
    print("\n--- STDOUT ---")
    print(result.stdout)
    
    if result.stderr:
        print("\n--- STDERR ---")
        print(result.stderr)
        
    if result.returncode == 0:
        print("\n--- CONCLUSION: Ground Truth Generation Succeeded ---")
    else:
        print(f"\n--- CONCLUSION: Ground Truth Generation FAILED (Exit Code: {result.returncode}) ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
